canonical_title: Kioxia and Sandisk plan over $31B Japan memory investment
aliases: Kioxia Sandisk AI flash memory investment
treatment: Covered as a major AI-memory supply investment. Repeat only for final government support, material project changes, production start, capacity figures, or new AI-specific product details.
known_facts: Kioxia and Sandisk announced planned investments totaling over $31 billion in Japan through 2032, contingent on government support.
The program includes infrastructure at Yokkaichi and Kitakami and aims to expand flash-memory supply for AI and data-driven demand.
Kioxia said a new Kitakami memory facility represents about 1.8 trillion yen of investment.
Kioxia and Sandisk are manufacturing 10th-generation BiCS Flash at Kitakami.
reinclude_only_if: Japanese government support is formally finalized or materially changed.
The companies disclose material capacity, production-start, technology-generation, or AI-specific supply details.
A material change occurs to the investment amount, timeline, or plant scope.
notes: Night-window hard delta; official Kioxia/Sandisk announcement and Reuters reporting agree on the >$31B through-2032 plan.
